dispositions.rationale: Owns reusable failure-pressure and governance-bypass HOW. Standards assurance/reliability define properties and evidence, while ecc:santa-method is a multi-agent convergence workflow rather than an equivalent fault-model methodology.
Mandatory Foundation organizational-role owner for routing, planning authority, task creation, and review judgment; external L2 capability cannot own or grant this authority.
Pinned capability sources contain no exact Cloud Run capability. Awesome is discovery-only, so no admissible external capability can replace the deployment identity/IAM/cost/verification HOW.

superpowers:systematic-debugging owns the generic reproduce/narrow/hypothesis/root-cause/fix method. Foundation retains only authority/scope boundaries, incident coordination, mitigation labeling, and routing to version-sensitive research.

Owns reusable architecture/design integrity HOW against target authority. documents/ owns project documentation truth and standards/ owns engineering requirements, but neither supplies this review method and no exact pinned external capability is equivalent.
Mandatory Foundation organizational-role owner for exact task execution, mutation gates, divergence handling, local hygiene, execution bundling, and report production.

documents/DOCUMENT_MODEL.md owns documentation closure, but this skill provides broader reusable completeness analysis for plans, contracts, migrations, and implementation proposals; no exact pinned external capability covers that scope.

Foundation-specific Git authority, canonical-remote, promotion-lineage, phase-capability, and release separation are material. ecc:git-workflow includes generic branch, rebase, hook, global-config, and force-push assumptions that are not compatible replacement semantics.

ecc:benchmark-optimization-loop owns the generic measured baseline/bottleneck/variant/re-measure loop. Foundation retains only bundle/synchronization optimization, assurance-preserving constraints, and routing across simplicity, verification, reliability, and cost.

standards/standards/reliability.yaml owns reliability requirements/evidence, while this skill owns reusable failure/recovery/incident HOW. No exact pinned external capability provides a compatible generic replacement.

Pinned external research capabilities add background-agent, monitoring, recommendation, or repo-note workflow assumptions. Foundation retains its generic source-order, claim-classification, conflict-resolution, freshness, and stop-condition HOW; L1 independent fan-out remains contract-owned.

ecc:search-first mixes package scoring, harness-specific agents/MCP discovery, and implementation actions. Foundation needs a smaller generic build-versus-reuse method aligned with exact capability-state and supply-chain boundaries.

standards/standards/security.yaml owns security requirements/evidence. ecc:security-review is a framework-heavy checklist and is not semantically equivalent to Foundation's concrete threat-path and trust-boundary review HOW.

Owns reusable solution-ladder, source-structure, and evidence-backed governance change-admission HOW. Maintainability/efficiency standards constrain outcomes but do not replace this method; no exact pinned external capability is equivalent.

External verification capabilities are completion-gate or harness-specific loops. Foundation retains acceptance-to-evidence design, evidence-layer separation, deterministic execution-bundle semantics, and authoritative-verification boundaries; assurance standards own requirements rather than HOW.
